# SOURCE
~~~sysml
package QuantityEvaluation {
    private import SI::*;
    private import ISQ::*;
    private import NumericalFunctions::*;
    attribute count : ScalarValues::Integer = 3;
    attribute doubled : ScalarValues::Integer = count * 2 + 1;
    attribute sensing : DurationValue = 25 [ms];
    attribute braking : DurationValue = 50 [ms];
    attribute chain : DurationValue = sensing + braking;
    attribute difference : DurationValue = braking - sensing;
    attribute scaled : DurationValue = sensing * 2;
    attribute reversedScale : DurationValue = 2 * sensing;
    attribute divided : DurationValue = braking / 2;
    attribute negative : DurationValue = -sensing;
    attribute seconds : DurationValue = 1 [s];
    attribute mixed : DurationValue = sensing + seconds;
    attribute propagated : DurationValue = mixed * 2;
    attribute zeroDivisor : DurationValue = sensing / 0;
    attribute propagatedZero : DurationValue = zeroDivisor + braking;
    attribute area : AreaValue = 80 [m^2];
    attribute computedUnit : AccelerationValue = 3 [m / s^2];
    attribute noValue : DurationValue;
    attribute nonConstant : DurationValue = noValue + sensing;
    attribute total : DurationValue = sum(sensing, braking);
    attribute maximum : DurationValue = max(sensing, braking);
    attribute minimum : DurationValue = NumericalFunctions::min(sensing, braking);
    attribute ambiguousMinimum : DurationValue = min(sensing, braking);
    attribute qualifiedTotal : DurationValue = NumericalFunctions::sum(sensing, braking);
    attribute nestedTotal : DurationValue = sum(sensing, max(sensing, braking));
    attribute sequenceTotal : DurationValue = sum((sensing, braking));
    attribute mixedSum : DurationValue = sum(sensing, seconds);
    attribute mixedMax : DurationValue = max(sensing, seconds);
    attribute missingCall = missingFunction(1, 2);
    attribute exactMaximum = NumericalFunctions::max(9007199254740992, 9007199254740993);
    attribute exactMinimum = NumericalFunctions::min(9007199254740993, 9007199254740992);
    part def Motor { attribute mass : MassValue = 0.14 [kg]; }
    part def Train {
        part left : Motor;
        part right : Motor;
        attribute mass : MassValue = left.mass + right.mass;
    }
    part def RedefinedTrain {
        part left : Motor { attribute :>> mass = 0.20 [kg]; }
        part right : Motor;
        attribute mass : MassValue = left.mass + right.mass;
    }
    package Local {
        calc def sum { in x : ScalarValues::Integer; in y : ScalarValues::Integer; return : ScalarValues::Integer = x - y; }
        attribute customSum = sum(2, 3);
    }
    view def Filtered {
        filter count > 2;
        filter NumericalFunctions::max(count, 2) == 3;
    }
}
~~~
